Warning! This filter seems to be made from sharp compressed carbon that can shed and could contaminate your drinking water.

A few weeks after installing this filter my wife and I experienced the same urinary tract extreme discomfort, it felt like peeing glass shards.
We went to the doctors for testing and the tests came in negative, the doctors were not able to find the cause of our pain.
I decided to crack open this water filter one morning when I was in a great deal of pain; I found that the filter seems to be made of a compressed carbon, the sharp carbon like shards easily came off on my finger when I ran my finger across the inside of the filter. I then replaced the OnePurify filter with an O.E.M. filter, after a few weeks of healing our health is back to normal.

If you have had the same experience, please contact Amazon customer service to have this item removed and review this product to warn others.

P.S.I contacted customer service at OnePurify and received confirmation they received the complaint, the company never responded back.

I purchased RFC1000A about 6 months ago in preparation to to replace the filter in my LG refrigerator this month (September) as it would be due to be changed out. Now I have purchased this filter in the past and have not had any issues with them, until yesterday when I went to replace the filter. As usual I replaced the filter and began the process of flushing it as I have done in the past and like the instructions stated. This is where the fun begins, I opened the refrigerator door to find water leaking from the filter drain hole so I wiped the water up and placed a cup under it. I then ran the water dispenser and watched as water was coming out of the drain hole once I finished dispensing water. I took the filter out as I thought maybe it wasn't seated correctly and that is when I saw on the label that it was for a Samsung-Kenmore refrigerator. I then looked at the box it came in and it shows that it "Fits LG" right on the cover but when I pulled out the instruction pamphlet it also stated it was for a Samsung-Kenmore refrigerator. I compared the two filters and they are different as the holes where the filter connects connects to the unit are totally different. Needless to say I don't believe I will be purchasing this filter brand again as they obviously don't check what is being packaged. I am just thankful that I saw the water coming out before it turned into a bigger problem i.e. ruining the food that is in the refrigerator or worst leaking all over the kitchen
